title: The Man Who Bought a Parrot

lines.text: Bleep you! Bleep your bleeping shoes!
lines.caption: #@$%! YOU! #@$% YOUR #@$%-ING SHOES!

lines.text: Finally, he lost it. He put the parrot in the freezer.
He opened the door. The parrot stepped out.
I am deeply sorry for my language, sir. It will never happen again.
May I ask... what did the chicken do?
